sentences.text: South Gippsland Water’s 2025-26 report described water services to 22,875 customer connections and wastewater services to 21,135 connections.
sentences.section: Statement by the Chair and Managing Director

sentences.text: The corporation reported completing a temporary Korumburra-to-Leongatha pipeline and adding 4.5 megalitres of clear water storage at Lance Creek.
sentences.section: Statement by the Chair and Managing Director

sentences.text: It reported moving its operations to 100 per cent renewable electricity and reducing emissions by 45 per cent.
sentences.section: Statement by the Chair and Managing Director

sentences.text: South Gippsland Water reported delivering 79% of planned capital expenditure, spending $26.0 million against $33.1 million in its corporate plan.
The corporation reported a loss before tax of $20.7 million for 2025-26.

items.quote: The full year operating result for 2025–26 was a loss before tax of $20.7m.
